title: Genuine hospital billing call
blurb: Manipal Hospital's billing desk explains the insurance pre-authorisation and says payment happens at the counter after discharge, with a receipt.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning, this is Neha from the billing desk at Manipal Hospital. Am I speaking with Mr. Fernandes, the attendant for Mrs. Fernandes in room 412?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that's me. Is everything alright?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes sir, she is doing well. I'm calling about the insurance. The pre-authorisation from Star Health has been approved for 1 lakh 40 thousand, so most of the bill is covered.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh good. Will there be anything for me to pay?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Only the non-medical items, roughly 6 to 8 thousand. You can pay at the billing counter on the ground floor at the time of discharge, by card, UPI or cash, and you'll get a printed receipt.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you need my card details now to block the amount?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No sir, we don't take any card details on the phone. Everything is done at the counter in person.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. When is the discharge likely?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The doctor will decide on rounds tomorrow morning. We'll message you the final bill summary on WhatsApp so you can check it before you come down.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You're welcome sir. If you have any questions, the billing desk number is on the admission slip.

source: authored for evaluation (paraphrased from public advisories)
